ordered_branches.explanation: Counts header receipt dates as past, today, tomorrow, same DATEPART week+year, same month+year, and future after today using warehouse-local time. Categories overlap and NULL receipt dates enter none; no chart ORDER BY. Summary includes every open receipt in warehouse regardless of date, counts headers and sums stored TOTAL_LINES/TOTAL_VALUE. Bare numeric variables use zero scale, so fractional value precision is not retained by these variables. DATEPART week depends on session settings and differs from the explicit week range in downstream type/vendor charts.

source_structure.declaration: CREATE PROCEDURE RCPT_MonitorReceiptsDatesChartData @filterCriteria NVARCHAR(MAX), @culture NVARCHAR(10) AS

program.text: SELECT @warehouse = filterValue from @criteriaTempTable WHERE filterName = N'<literal:1>'
SET @PAST_COUNT=(SELECT COUNT(RECEIPT_DATE) from RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE CONVERT(DATE,RECEIPT_DATE) < (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate)) AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL );
SET @TODAY_COUNT=(SELECT COUNT(RECEIPT_DATE) from RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE CONVERT(DATE,RECEIPT_DATE) = (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate)) AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
SET @TOM_COUNT=(SELECT COUNT(RECEIPT_DATE) from RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE CONVERT(DATE,RECEIPT_DATE) = (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate+1)) AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
SET @FUTURE_COUNT=(SELECT COUNT(RECEIPT_DATE) from RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE CONVERT(DATE,RECEIPT_DATE) > (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate))
AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
FROM RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE WAREHOUSE = @warehouse AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL;
